failure_location.quote:
For a weighted, undirected graph, the quadratic form of the unnormalized Laplacian, normalized by the degree matrix, is bounded by 2.
$$ \sup_{\bm{y} \ne \bm{0}} \frac{\bm{y}^T(D-W)\bm{y}}{\bm{y}^T D \bm{y}} = 2 $$

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the asserted equality by an inequality. Any equality assertion must carry an appropriate additional graph condition and justification.
issues.overall_effect: The exact extremal-value assertion is false, although the upper bound used elsewhere remains established.
issues.title: The normalized-Laplacian upper bound is incorrectly stated as universal equality
issues.why_classification: This is a limited weakening from a false exact-value theorem to the valid universal bound; it withdraws mathematical content but requires no new proof architecture.
